Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's only a draft, so nothing has been sent.

It ends with a question for June about the full names to use and who owns the relabel. It's signed from you, so please read it through before you send it.
